label: history:commit-message-mining
summary: Mined 1319 commits on origin/main (2026-03-04 to 2026-07-06). No formal `git revert` commits exist (only one message literally starts with 'Revert'); manual 'revert' mentions (5) are mostly accidental governance-report timestamp files leaking into commits and being backed out, plus one bigger CI-workflow restoration after a messy uncommitted-work rescue. The dominant confusion generator is 'docops': a hardcoded markdown file/line-count manifest that required 46+ separate 'fix(docops): refresh/correct counts' commits, explicitly diagnosed twice as a 'counter cascade' before being made advisory. A second cross-cutting theme is repeated 'honesty' bugs: components silently self-reporting false success (CI's -x masking 46 failing tests, providers wrongly reporting 'no provider', evolution archive faking gates_passed, A2A send paths, automerge gate) surfaced and were patched across ~7 unrelated subsystems over the whole history. Merge Master Mike (merge automation) and provider routing were each patched 4-10 times for the same class of failure. Guardian (dup-issue bot) needed 3 dedup-storm fixes. A ~10-commit security-hardening burst on 'review mark authority' landed within 4 days (June 2-5), suggesting the feature shipped under-scoped.

label: agent-confusion:instructions-and-onboarding
summary: CLAUDE.md, BUILD_SESSION_ENTRYPOINT.md, and CANONICAL_DOC_STACK.md form a genuinely self-aware anti-decay system: they explicitly admit past failures (frozen wrong counts, a section that rotted twice, an earlier wrong max-5-docs claim) and redirect volatile facts to live commands (make onboard, check_track_status.py, spine_bypass_report.py) instead of freezing them in prose. That works for axiom/gate/mismatch counts. But leaks remain: the ACTIVE_TRACK block is copy-pasted byte-for-byte into both CLAUDE.md and BUILD_SESSION_ENTRYPOINT.md instead of one owning and one linking; DEVIN.md knowingly restates a subset of CLAUDE.md's rules for emphasis and has already drifted (500-line rule gained an unstated exception, the 2026-06-18 worktree-budget rule never propagated); and QWEN.md is an ungoverned, stale, session-specific file with a hardcoded old branch/path that CANONICAL_DOC_STACK's ownership table never mentions, so nothing catches it going stale. CLAUDE.md is also ~55% rendered Intent-layer state inside a file its own doctrine calls Behavioral-layer.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: render_active_track_includes.py renders the same YAML-derived block into every file with the ACTIVE_TRACK markers, rather than one file owning the rendered prose and others linking to it.
findings.recurrence: Every ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml change requires both copies to be re-rendered together; a partial render/commit lets the two silently diverge, the same drift class CLAUDE.md admits happening twice already to INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.
findings.one_and_done_fix: Make BUILD_SESSION_ENTRYPOINT.md link/transclude the CLAUDE.md-rendered block instead of embedding a second full copy, or have CI fail if the two rendered copies differ.
findings.blast_radius: Low-probability but repo-wide: if it drifts, every agent reading BUILD_SESSION_ENTRYPOINT.md instead of CLAUDE.md silently gets stale track state.

findings.recurrence: Any future Qwen/GLM/open-model session reading QWEN.md by DEVIN.md-style convention inherits a stale branch, stale path, and a task brief for work no longer in the active portfolio.
findings.one_and_done_fix: Archive QWEN.md under docs/archive/ with a redirect, or rewrite it as a durable operational-pattern file structured like DEVIN.md (defers to CLAUDE.md, carries no session-specific state).

findings.title: CLAUDE.md's own doctrine says active state belongs in YAML, not prose, yet ~55% of the file's lines are the rendered Intent-layer portfolio

evidence.note: Three-Layer SSoT model: CLAUDE.md is the Behavioural-contract file; 'Active state lives in YAML or live registers, not in prose' (Anti-Doc-Maze rule 4)
~250 of CLAUDE.md's ~454 lines are the rendered 5-track ACTIVE_TRACK portfolio, i.e. Intent-layer state, not Behavioral-layer content

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The render-block mechanism avoids agents needing a second file for track context, but inverts the doc stack's own separation: CLAUDE.md is meant to be the stable behavioral contract yet by line count is dominated by the fastest-changing content in the repo.
findings.recurrence: Every track open/close/verify cycle re-renders a large chunk of the file agents are told is their behavioral contract, raising the odds that rules below it (Security, State Directory, Navigation) get skimmed or truncated.
findings.one_and_done_fix: Move the rendered block out of CLAUDE.md into a short dedicated include file that CLAUDE.md links to, keeping CLAUDE.md itself close to pure Behavioral doctrine.
